page_title: UNI 2-1 DOR | Union Berlin v Dortmund 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) sees a yellow card from Tobias Reichel after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+4' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) has received a yellow card for his foul.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Reichel didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
86' The substitution is prepared. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Julian Ryerson.

86' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
85' Tobias Reichel shows the yellow card to Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) for a heavy challenge.
83' The foul by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Reichel.
82' The foul by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) was seen by Tobias Reichel who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
77' It's time for a substitution. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) comes on in place of Benedict Hollerbach.
76' Nuri Sahin decides to make a substitution. Emre Can will be replaced by Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund).
75' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
71' Dortmund failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Substitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) replaces Woo-Yeong Jeong.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yorbe Vertessen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin).
67' Here is a change. Aljoscha Kemlein is going off and Bo Svensson gives the last tactical orders to Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) replaces Pascal Gross.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jamie Gittens departs the field of play to be replaced by Donyell Malen (Dortmund).
62' 2 - 1 Goal! Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
60' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Kevin Vogt and he is replaced by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin).
59' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) commits a foul and Tobias Reichel immediately signals a free kick.
57' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tobias Reichel who sees an offensive foul.
55' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
54' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Gregor Kobel has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
52' Yan Couto (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
51' None of the Dortmund players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
48' The game is interrupted. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' 2 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a daisy-cutter into the middle of the goal. Even though his attempt wasn't very accurate, Gregor Kobel couldn't stop it, so the score changes to 2:0.
45' Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.

44' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Gregor Kobel does well to punch it away.
41' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) picks up a yellow card.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.

40' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Good work from Union Berlin as they win a corner.

37' A clever short pass gives Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
36' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pascal Gross (Dortmund).
36' The referee blows his whistle as Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in his challenge.
34' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Rani Khedira.
33' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but Gregor Kobel comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' A player from Union Berlin commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
30' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Union Berlin earn a corner.
29' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yan Couto (Dortmund).
26' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Gregor Kobel no chance!
25' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is going to take the penalty!
24' Rough tackle by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Union Berlin!
23' Tobias Reichel blows the whistle, Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) is penalised for a foul.

20' Excellent touch by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

19' Yan Couto (Dortmund) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
18' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Gregor Kobel.
17' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
15' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) for a tough tackle.
12' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
10' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.

8' That was close by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
8' Gregor Kobel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
4' Emre Can (Dortmund) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
3' Yan Couto (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
1' The first half has started.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Tobias Reichel will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
